reference.title: Shader Paper Shred Scroll Parallax Interaction

beats: At rest a cut line sits 0.85 of the way down the paper; below it the paper hangs as strips about 17.5 px wide over the dark section, each curled so the light finds its crown, swaying slowly
Scrolling moves the cut line up the paper to the header; everything below it hangs as strips
Further scroll makes a wave run down the strips, growing with the scroll
Then the strip ends rise, ragged strip by strip, and the strips lift away to reveal the dark section and its line; the header stays
